text:
nina-peopleops: Heads-up: conversion packet for NewGrad (Priya) — current internship ends 8/15, manager requests FT start 8/16 with benefits active day one. Seeks L240k base, $6k sign-on, prorated RSUs, and 9-month clawback. Need routing + policy check.

omar-recruit: Candidate verbally accepted contingent on written offer. Manager stresses retention; competitor outreach happened last week.

rana-mgr: Quick context: Priya drove perf improvements in our infra testing infra; hard to replace. Prefer 9-month clawback to balance candidate goodwill and company protection.

nina-peopleops: Policy note: standard new-hire sign-on clawback is 12 months for external hires; conversions sometimes flexible. We need committee approval for <12 months. Also benefits usually start on first day but HRIS must be ready by payroll cutoff.

payroll-bot: Payroll timeline: to make benefits active on 8/16 we need signed offer + HRIS entry by COB Mon. Off-cycle PTO accrual for conversions needs separate ticket.

equity-team: Equity proration: we can prorate the first year grant to the nearest quarter if we get start date and grant size now. Any nonstandard vesting must be approved.

finance-ops: Preliminary budget check: L2 $140k base + $6k sign-on is within hiring premium. Tag GL ENG-2026-08-NG. Approve routing to exceptions committee if manager justification included.

legal-bot: 9-month clawback is unusual but workable in WA if written clearly. Recommend: repayment triggered if voluntary separation or termination for cause within 9 months; repayment terms spelled out; avoid automatic payroll deductions language until candidate consents. For CA hires, 9-month may be problematic; recommend 12 months in CA.

rana-mgr: Candidate is US (NY), so check state rules. If CA is problematic, manager ok with 12 months. Prefer 9 but can accept 12.

talent-ops: Routing checklist: manager justification + headcount code + GL tag + start date + signed offer deadline. Please paste justification.

nina-peopleops: Manager justification: "critical ownership of infra test harness; multiple external outreach events; ramp time > 3 months; losing would delay roadmap milestone." Headcount code ENG-2026-08-NG.

omar-recruit: Candidate ETA to sign: within 48 hours of receiving offer. Wants benefits day-one as well.

nina-peopleops: I'll bundle packet and kick to recruiting lead -> finance -> people-ops exceptions committee -> legal. Note: committee expects standardized clawback language, repayment schedule, and PTO accrual plan.

legal-bot: I'll draft a 9-month clawback template and a 12-month fallback for CA. Send packet and I'll attach redlines.

equity-team: Please confirm grant amount. If we do 600 RSUs prorated, we need final approval from equity approver.

finance-ops: Budget provisional OK. Approve packet to committee. Mark as hiring premium and note expected 1st year cash impact.

payroll-bot: Reminder: HRIS cutoff Mon COB for benefits start 8/16. If missed, benefits will start next month. Off-cycle accrual ticket must be created for PTO adjustments.

nina-peopleops: Committee in 4 hours. If approved, we'll aim to send offer same day. Keep thread short; archive after acceptance. :white_check_mark:
